items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: I think Don Byers played, but we was playing along with Erskine Hawkins and Tab Smith during that time.

ctx.x: I was hooked up all kinds of ways and didn't know. I found that out, we were playing a lot of Army camps and naval bases. And he was right there with us, not saying anything. So we played three states in one day. We left from Milwaukee, Wisconsin, Sioux Falls, South Dakota, Sioux City, Iowa, and Great Bench, Kansas. That night we ended up. And we played there and here was the FBI in there. Called me over, two young fellas, you know. And they called about four or five names of Lamont that I didn't know. They were…

You brought up a point about, you've worked with a lot of big band leaders. Oh, yeah. Jay McShann. How do you, how do you rate Jay McShann? How was Jay McShann as a band leader as opposed to maybe other people?
